text:
Ana: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands — a few folks asked for concrete dates for API rate-tier changes, Console rollout for the new rollout UI, and Optimize GA. Can we confirm rough weeks so I can update the public roadmap?

Kevin: Short answers: API rate-tier changes are targeted for mid-May (week of 2026-05-11). That’s when the quota UI + backend enforcement land in prod. Still on track but could slip a week if perf regressions pop.

Maria: Console rollout (new rollout UI + canary controls) aiming for end of June. Beta tenants start late May. We’re gating on analytics hooks and RBAC polish.

Peter: From runtime side, Optimize integration (batching recommendations + quant profiles) is feature-complete but needs two perf sweeps. Targeting GA in early July, assuming no infra blockers.

Dalia: Quick note — DevEx will publish a migration guide and sample configs the week before each beta. I’ll draft the checklist this week.

Ana: Thanks. Can we call out any hard dependencies that would cause >2 week delay?

Kevin: Major risks: kernel patch on some GPU drivers (if it lands late), and the analytics event schema break from Console. We have mitigation plans (fallback to legacy quota checks, schema compatibility layer).

Peter: Also watch for model-catalog changes that affect quantization profiles — that could require extra validation.

Maria: Action items: 1) I’ll update the roadmap board with tentative weeks. 2) Peter, please flag any driver issues by next Tue (1976543320). 3) Dalia, share the migration checklist draft by Fri.

Dalia: Roger — will post the checklist in #devex and ping here.

OpsBot: Meeting note: all-hands follow-up captured under /notes/1976543210. Assigned: Maria (roadmap update), Peter (runtime risk review), Dalia (migration checklist).

Ana: Perfect — if anything changes, post updates here so we don’t misalign external comms. :thumbsup:
